items.title: sync-api: store transcriptions per account (schema v3 and a store)

red_tree_stubs.note: signature-only: the store types of this item (PushResult, StoredTranscription, TranscriptionStore with push and list) are declared at the end of the ride-along fixture so it compiles on the base; every store call throws, because the base has no store. Legs that test the schema and the migration then fail on their own assertions (the version is still 2, no transcriptions table), and store legs fail on the missing behaviour
